chapter_title: Concerning the Five Forms that exist in the Rulers

spiritual_reading.full_translation:
Attend to the ruling principle that commands the whole infernal order. Within that ruling principle there is a sufficient set of fundamental modes, drawn from the complete range of perversions that arise through the degrees of that domain.

In its highest part there is the domination of self-love, kindled from corrupt love. In what should elevate and give clear discernment there is instead proud reasoning and restless persuasive thought. In its operative powers and in its outermost effects there is cruelty and destructive desire, for its action is driven by obscured understanding and thickened falsity. In its inner appetite there is devouring falsity that swallows every perception of good and truth, because it is fed by active denial. In its last extension there is falsified truth severed from life and made into mere knowledge that serves evil. These fundamental modes are within it, and they proceed from the complete set of perverted formations in that infernal order.

Whenever it wills, it can act from gross falsities in the outermost degree alone. Whenever it wills, it can also bring a fuller complement of forces into agreement for assault, until corrupt love burns in unified vehemence. Whenever it wills, it can lift itself into airy persuasion and operate by subtle reasoning that seems to rise above what is merely natural. Whenever it wills, it can immerse itself in falsified truths and reason from them as though they were living. Again, whenever it wills, it can abase itself into mere denial and cling to it with appetite, thinking from darkness as though darkness were wisdom. These modes are within it.

There are also three further qualities within it.

The first is its ability to arrange and deploy its subordinate evils and falsities into order for whatever it intends.

The second is its power of deceptive persuasion: whenever it wills, it can withdraw its governing presence so that its subordinate forces do not perceive what rules them; and whenever it wills, it can disclose itself to them and compel them, inflicting spiritual death by its persuasive arts. Whatever it then utters, it can make effective as if by an enforced authority.

The third is its stubborn resistance to being overcome: its state is hardened in fixed selfhood so that the assaults of subordinate evils and falsities cannot break it. No merely external strength in the natural degree can equal or destroy this resistance, because it was brought into fixed form from the unyielding counsel of selfhood, the generative source of destructive desires and their persuasions.

Again, there are three further states within it.

Whenever it wills, the ardor of corrupt love flares up, and its whole state becomes as though nothing but that ardor were present.

Also, whenever it wills, it can pour out a contrary coldness, and its whole state becomes a total lack of charity, as though love itself had frozen.

Finally, its perception of those who serve it is limited: while its subordinate forces are immediately within its sphere and under its dominion, it can discern their intentions and understand what is within their interior thought from what they present outwardly. But when they withdraw from its immediate presence and separate themselves, it no longer discerns what they intend inwardly. There is no genuine spiritual life in it at all; what appears as life is only the agitation of anger and the fear of losing dominion that shows itself outwardly. Its will is fixed upon the destruction it continually sets before itself as its end. At this point the thread of expression falters, but the bent toward ruin remains the closing force.

paragraph_translations.translation: Attend to the ruling principle, the leading power over every perverted affection and every falsity that rises from denial of good. Within that ruling principle there is a sufficient set of fundamental modes, patterned after the complete range of perversions that arise through the degrees of that infernal order.

In its highest part there is the domination of self-love, taking its determination from the ardor of corrupt love. In what should serve discernment and elevation there is instead proud reasoning and the soaring persuasion of restless thought. In its operative powers and in its outermost effects there is cruelty and destructive desire, for its actions are formed from obscured understanding and from falsities that thicken into consent. In its inmost appetite there is devouring falsity that swallows every perception of good and truth, because it draws from active denial. In its last extension there is falsified truth severed from life and turned into mere knowledge that serves evil. These fundamental modes are within it, and they proceed from the complete set of perverted formations in that domain.

Whenever it wills, it can act from gross falsities in the outermost degree alone. Whenever it wills, it can also act by a fuller complement of forces, bringing its interior and exterior powers into agreement for assault, until corrupt love burns in unified vehemence. Whenever it wills, it can lift its thought into airy persuasion and operate by subtle reasoning that seems to rise above what is merely natural. Whenever it wills, it can immerse itself in falsified truths and reason from them as though they were living. Again, whenever it wills, it can abase itself into mere denial and cling to it with appetite, reasoning from darkness as though darkness were wisdom. These modes are within it.
paragraph_translations.notes: The damaged bracketed phrases in the source create some uncertainty in the second mode; the translation assumes coordinated action of interior/exterior powers leading to intensified corrupt love.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: The chapter is largely coherent as a single portrayal of an infernal ruling principle: first its five fundamental modes through the degrees, then its ability to shift among them, then two triads of additional qualities and states. Coherence weakens only where the source is damaged (mustering powers; final sentence), but the spiritual narrative remains continuous: a life-less dominion driven by corrupt love, alternating heat and cold, using deceptive persuasion, with limited perception and an end of destruction.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential substrate: the teaching is by functional correspondence (body parts/animal forms ↔ worlds/creations; locomotions ↔ modes of operation). No governance layer intrudes; the narrative develops smoothly from anatomy to behavior.
findings.evidence: Text grounds meaning in what the ruler *is* and *can do*: “five forms exist in his body, corresponding to … the five creations … five worlds of Darkness” (¶1). Then each part is mapped by likeness/derivation (“head is lion-faced… from the world of fire… tail … fish … children of water,” ¶2) and immediately turned into functional capacities (“Should he wish, he shall walk… crawl… rise up… plunge… crawl on his belly,” ¶3). The spiritual reading reports OPEN→DEVELOPS continuity here and only notes minor bracket-damage uncertainty, not a conceptual mismatch.

findings.diagnosis: Clean continuation with a numerical seam, but still substrate-like: a triad of capacities described as functions (mustering, concealment/manifestation, invulnerability). The “Also, there are three other” is a structural hinge, not an administrative overlay.
findings.evidence: The content stays in functional verbs rather than jurisdictions: “marshal his powers according to his will” (¶5); “make an invocation… hide… show himself… strike… Any word… work magic” (¶6); “body is strong… nails and claws… not able to penetrate… No iron nor copper… because he was formed… from… counsel of Matter” (¶7). The spiritual reading marks this as SHIFTS then DEVELOPS, with only damage-based inference in ¶5 and obscured phrasing in ¶6—i.e., the reader did not stumble because of voice intrusion but because of lacunae.

findings.diagnosis: Mixed: ¶8-10 remain functional and coherent, but ¶11 is textually damaged at the end, producing the only real narrative break. The stumble is not from an administrative insertion but from fragmentary transmission (corruption/loss) in the closing clause(s).
findings.evidence: ¶8-10 form a clear functional triad: “fire shall blaze… body… substance of fire” (¶9); “send out frost… freezes… snow” (¶10). ¶11 begins coherently with a bounded-perception function (“look at them and understand… so long as they are stood before him… when they retreat… he shall not understand,” ¶11), then continues with an intelligible doctrinal line (“There is no life in him whatsoever, but his ‘life’ is the bile of anger…”), but collapses into garble: “Shall a [man set before him the] destruction that is establ[fore him]fore him.” The spiritual reading explicitly flags this as BREAKS and notes “textually broken and partly unintelligible… expression breaks into an unfinished threat,” which is the hallmark of damage rather than a voice shift.

textual_criticism.summary: 3 findings: (1) ¶1-3 clean correspondential substrate; (2) ¶4-7 clean functional continuation despite minor lacunae; (3) ¶8-11 coherent through ¶10, with ¶11 ending in clear textual damage. No administrative/governance overlay detected; no excision or annotation recommended.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: Consider the ruler, the leader of all the powers of Darkness. Now, five forms exist in his body, corresponding to (the archetype) of the five creations that exist in the five worlds of Darkness.

Indeed, his head is lion-faced, which came about from the world of fire. His wings and his shoulders are eagle-faced, after the likeness of the children of the wind. His hands and his feet are daemons, after the likeness of the children of the world of smoke. His belly is dragon-faced, after the likeness of the world of Darkness. His tail is the form of the fish, which belongs to the world of the children of water. These five shapes are in him, and they came from the five creations of the five worlds of Darkness.

⟨p.78⟩
Should he wish, he shall walk on his two feet [like the children of the] world of smoke. Also, when he wants, he shall [crawl on his] four [feet, and walk] on his hands and feet [and burn] like the children of fire. Should he wish, he shall rise up on his wings, like the children of the wind. Also, should he wish, he shall plunge down to the waters like the children of water. Again, should he wish, he shall crawl on his belly like the children of Darkness. These five shapes are in him.
Also, there are three other (qualities) in him.
The first: [He shall marshal] his powers [according to his will.]

The second: Shall a [man conceal by] his magic arts. When he wishes, he shall make an invocation over himself, and hide from his powers. When he wants, he shall show himself to them and strike a death-blow by his magic arts. Any word he might utter at that moment, he shall [work magic] by it.

The third: His body is strong, a[l]] [so that the] nails and claws of his powers are not able to penetrate it. No iron nor copper body will equal him [in strength]; they will not be able to destroy him, because he was formed and fashioned from the hard-hearted counsel of Matter, the mother of demons and fiends.
Again, there are three others in him.
When he wants, his fire shall {blaze), and his entire body be made like the [substance of] fire.
Also, when he wishes, he shall send out frost, and his entire body freezes like a [body of] snow.

The third: Whenever his powers are stood before him, he shall look at them and understand; for [whatever exists]ists in their heart he shall understand, what is in their heart and their face so long as they are stood before him. When they retreat before him and distance themselves from him, he shall not understand what is in their heart. There is no life in him whatsoever, but his 'life' is the bile of anger that is apparent on his face and in his fear. Shall a [man set before him the] destruction that is establ[fore him]fore him.

changes_summary: No changes made. All findings (Finding 1–3) recommended “none,” including the damaged ending of ¶11, so no excisions were executed.
